instruction: In the spreadsheet, identify which month had the highest total sales across all sales representatives and highlight that month's header cell with any background color.

metadata.explanation: Task requires identifying the month with highest total sales and highlighting its header. Evaluator dynamically calculates total sales for each month by summing all sales rep values, identifies which month has the maximum total, then verifies that the correct month header cell is highlighted with background color. Score breakdown: 0.3 for highlighting the correct month (the one with maximum total sales), 0.7 for applying background highlighting to the cell.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly calculates total sales for each month column dynamically by summing all sales rep values (getters/xlsx.py:38-73)
Getter correctly identifies which month has maximum total using max(month_totals, key=month_totals.get) (getters/xlsx.py:79)
Getter correctly scans all month header cells to find which is highlighted (getters/xlsx.py:87-94)
Getter correctly verifies that highlighted cell matches the max month cell (getters/xlsx.py:97)
Metric correctly awards 0.3 points for correct month identification via is_correct_month flag (metrics/xlsx.py:31-37)
Metric correctly awards 0.7 points for highlighting presence via has_fill flag (metrics/xlsx.py:39-44)
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies both requirements - correct month identification AND highlighting
Edge cases handled: empty headers (line 53), non-numeric values (lines 64-68), no month data (lines 75-77)
Postconfig correctly saves file with Ctrl+S ensuring fresh state for verification
Evaluator is fully dynamic and data-driven, no hardcoded values, will work correctly regardless of which month has maximum sales
